response.sql:
WITH per_race AS (
  SELECT raceId,
         AVG(points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings
  WHERE points > 6.0
  GROUP BY raceId
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins FROM per_race
)
SELECT p.raceId,
       p.avg_points,
       p.avg_wins,
       p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS diff
FROM per_race p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins) IS NULL,
         (p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins) DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The threshold is strict: only constructorStandings rows with points > 6.0 are used, and rows with NULL points are excluded by that comparison.

Per-race averages use only non-NULL values. A race whose wins are all NULL still appears, with a NULL average wins and NULL difference, sorted last. A race with no qualifying rows is absent from the output.
The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-race average wins, with NULL per-race values ignored. If that mean is NULL, the WHERE clause returns no rows.
constructorStandings.points and wins are season-to-date values, as the verified notes state and the request's wording implies, so no per-race point totals are recomputed.
